sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledgers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CNY', "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'personal', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "sync_id" TEXT NULL, "my_role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'owner', "member_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "is_shared" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_shared" IN (0, 1)), "owner_user_id" TEXT NULL, "month_start_day" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "storage_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "aa_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("aa_enabled" IN (0, 1)), CHECK (month_start_day BETWEEN 1 AND 28));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "parent_id" INTEGER NULL, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_id" TEXT NULL, CHECK (level IN (1, 2)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "ledger_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ledgers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "day_of_month" INTEGER NULL, "day_of_week" INTEGER NULL, "month_of_year" INTEGER NULL, "start_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date" INTEGER NULL, "last_generated_date" INTEGER NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), CHECK (interval >= 1), CHECK (day_of_month IS NULL OR day_of_month BETWEEN 1 AND 31), CHECK (day_of_week IS NULL OR day_of_week BETWEEN 1 AND 7), CHECK (month_of_year IS NULL OR month_of_year BETWEEN 1 AND 12));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "ledger_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ledgers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "category_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES categories (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "happened_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "note" TEXT NULL, "recurring_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES recurring_transactions (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "sync_id" TEXT NULL, "created_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "last_edited_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "category_sync_id_override" TEXT NULL, "exclude_from_stats" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclude_from_stats" IN (0, 1)), "currency_code" TEXT NULL, "native_amount" INTEGER NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_edited_at" INTEGER NULL, "paid_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "aa_mode" INTEGER NULL, "aa_participants" TEXT NULL, "aa_splits" TEXT NULL, CHECK (aa_mode IS NULL OR aa_mode IN (0, 1, 2)), CHECK ((currency_code IS NULL AND native_amount IS NULL) OR (currency_code IS NOT NULL AND native_amount IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "record_edit_histories" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "record_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "operator_user_id" TEXT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_changes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entity_sync_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ledger_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "pushed_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'spitout_cloud', "server_cursor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_push_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_pull_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_members" ("ledger_sync_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "account" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "avatar_url" TEXT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "joined_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("ledger_sync_id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shared_ledger_categories" ("ledger_sync_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sync_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "level" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "parent_name" TEXT NULL, "parent_sync_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("ledger_sync_id", "sync_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_pull_errors" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "change_id" INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE, "ledger_external_id" TEXT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_sync_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "raw_change_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_class" TEXT NULL, "error_message" TEXT NULL, "stack_trace" TEXT NULL, "first_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "user_action" TEXT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exchange_rates" ("base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("base_currency", "quote_currency", "rate_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exchange_rate_overrides" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "sync_id" TEXT NULL, "base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "snapshot_dirty_ledgers" ("ledger_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "dirty_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("ledger_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ledger_virtual_users" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "ledger_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sync_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NULL);
